title: "Canonical Correlation Analysis Report"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(CCAflow)
```

## Analysis

Create or load paired numeric blocks `X` and `Y`, then fit and validate the model.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
fit <- cca_fit(X, Y, method = "ridge", lambda_x = 0.1, lambda_y = 0.1)
cca_audit(X, Y)
cca_table(fit, "correlations")
cca_plot(fit, "scree")
cv <- cca_validate(X, Y, method = "ridge",
                   params = list(lambda_x = 0.1, lambda_y = 0.1))
plot(cv)
```
